summary.name: 智谱清言 (Zhipu Qingyan / ChatGLM)
summary.one_liner: Zhipu Qingyan (智谱清言) is a Chinese AI assistant and agent platform built on Zhipu's GLM large language models, with task modes for research reports, PPT creation and data analysis.
use_cases: chat with a knowledge base or local files
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Zhipu Qingyan as an agent-style assistant built on GLM models, aiming to carry out tasks by understanding goals, calling tools, and breaking work into steps. Task shortcuts listed include research reports, PPT creation, data analysis, creative posters, and web apps. Users can pick a model (GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.3-Flash) and a thinking-intensity setting, and optionally attach cloud knowledge bases or local files or turn on web search. The page also mentions desktop and mobile versions and a Mac app download (ZCode). Most of the page text is interface and marketing, so specific capability details beyond these listed features are not stated.
notable: Agent-style assistant built on GLM models that calls tools and decomposes tasks
Preset task modes: research reports, PPT creation, data analysis, posters, web apps
Model choice between GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash with adjustable thinking intensity
Can use cloud knowledge bases, local file upload, and web search mode
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the listing tags it #free but the page itself does not confirm this
Page is mostly interface and promotional text; detailed capability and limit information is not given
